title: Compositional neural networks for multimodal X-ray and neutron scattering inversion
abstract: arXiv:2610.29362v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: X-ray and neutron scattering are indispensable for structural characterization across condensed-matter physics and materials science. Yet, because scattering experiments generally record intensities without phase information, distinct structures can yield similar scattering patterns, rendering the corresponding inverse problems non-unique. This ambiguity can be reduced by combining complementary measurements, but their integration into machine-learning frameworks remains challenging. Here we introduce a modular framework for probabilistic multi-measurement analysis based on prior-amortized flow matching. Single-observation posterior estimators are trained separately for individual observation types or physical probes and combined only at inference time through a compositional sampler. translated_title: 用于多模态X射线和中子散射反演的组合式神经网络
translated_abstract: X射线和中子散射是凝聚态物理和材料科学中结构表征不可或缺的手段。然而，由于散射实验通常只记录强度而不含相位信息，不同的结构可能产生相似的散射图案，使得相应的逆问题不具有唯一性。通过结合互补的测量可以减少这种歧义，但将其整合到机器学习框架中仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们提出了一种基于先验摊销流匹配的概率性多测量分析模块化框架。针对每种观测类型或物理探针分别训练单观测后验估计器，并仅在推理时通过组合采样器将其结合。这种后期融合方法允许预训练的单观测模型被重复使用，而无需专门的联合再训练。作为一个典型案例，我们考虑反射率测量……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于先验摊销流匹配的模块化框架，通过在推理阶段用组合采样器融合分别训练的单观测后验估计器，实现多模态X射线和中子散射数据的概率性联合反演，无需联合再训练即可复用预训练模型。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a modular framework based on prior-amortized flow matching that fuses separately trained single-observation posterior estimators at inference time via a compositional sampler, enabling probabilistic multimodal inversion of X-ray and neutron scattering data while reusing pretrained models without joint retraining.
